'''David Edward Joyce''' is an American mathematician known for introducing [[quandle]]s in [[knot theory]],{{r|quandle}} and for his online interactive edition of [[Euclid's Elements|Euclid's ''Elements'']].{{r|barrow-green|kiernan}} He is a [[professor emeritus]] of mathematics at [[Clark University]].{{r|em}}

Joyce completed his Ph.D. in 1979 at the [[University of Pennsylvania]], with the dissertation ''An Algebraic Approach to Symmetry with Applications to Knot Theory'' supervised by [[Peter J. Freyd]].{{r|mg}} His doctoral dissertation introduced [[quandle]]s, and his work in this area was published in 1982, the same year as the independent publication of these structures under another name by {{ill|Sergei Matveev|ru|Матвеев, Сергей}}.{{r|quandle}}

He created his online edition of Euclid's ''Elements'' in 1996, using [[Java applet]]s to create interactive diagrams, with the dual purpose of creating more interest in Euclid's work and of showing off the capabilities of [[Java (programming language)|the Java programming language]] for mathematical illustration.{{r|resonance}}
